comparison: Observed BCE + soft Dice versus positive-weighted observed BCE + unchanged soft Dice
weight_rule: clip(sqrt(negative_pixels / positive_pixels), 1, 20) on observed training labels at 384px, padding excluded
other_controls: same float32, initialization seed, AdamW and learning rate as the unweighted diagnostic; no threshold or resolution change
purpose: Isolate foreground imbalance hypothesis; no validation/test tuning or generalization claim
implementation: Weighted objective must be implemented and gradient-tested before execution.
